component.name: Redragon Mouse
component.summary: Configure Redragon/Holtek gaming mice on Linux

description.p: A native Linux configuration tool for Redragon/Holtek USB gaming mice. It reads the mouse's registers through HID feature reports, lets you review every change before it is written, verifies the write by reading the registers back, and keeps a timestamped backup of the values it replaced.

Supported settings depend on the model descriptor: DPI stages, polling rate, lighting, onboard profiles, button mappings, macros, and global pointer settings. Unsupported or unverified capabilities are shown as such instead of being guessed.
First release: device discovery, read-back-first settings engine, backups, and the editor screens described in the project's OpenSpec change.
